# China Educational Tours

> > Educational travel company specializing in customized tours across China, featuring cultural heritage sites, historical landmarks, and authentic local experiences from Beijing to Tibet.

China Educational Tours offers comprehensive guided tours throughout China with expert local guides, covering major destinations like Beijing, Xi'an, Shanghai, Guilin, Chengdu, and Tibet. The site provides extensive travel guides, cultural insights, weather information, and culinary recommendations to help visitors experience China's rich history from the Tang and Qing dynasties to modern attractions.

## Key Topics

- China travel and tourism
- Beijing historical sites
- Xi'an and Terracotta Army
- Shanghai modern attractions
- Guilin and Lijiang River
- Tibet Buddhist monasteries
- Chinese cultural heritage
- Local cuisine and street food
- Tang Dynasty and Qing Dynasty history
- Wuhan and Hubei specialties
- Chinese tea culture
- Ancient water towns
- Chinese New Year traditions
- Local tour guides
- Weather and travel planning

- [5-Day Chengdu and Mt. Emei Tour](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/chengdu-tours/discovery-chengdu-emei.htm): 5-day Chengdu & Mt. Emei tour: pandas, Leshan Buddha & Buddhist temples
- [6-day Lhasa Monasteries and Shigatse Tour](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/tibet-tours/buddhism-tour-of-tibet.htm): 6-day Tibet tour: Lhasa monasteries, Potala Palace & Shigatse highlights
- [Tour Guides in Beijing](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/about/beijing-local-guides.htm): Beijing tour guide profiles including William Zhang & local experts

## Cultural Attractions and Heritage Sites

- [Lama Temple: The Largest Tibetan Buddhist Temple](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/beijing-lama-temple.htm): Lama Temple (Yonghegong): Beijing's largest Tibetan Buddhist temple
- [Shanghai World Financial Center](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/shanghai-world-financial-center.htm): 492m Shanghai World Financial Center in Pudong with observation deck
- [Xitang Water Town](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/hangzhou-xitang-water-town.htm): Xitang Water Town: 1000-year-old ancient town near Hangzhou & Shanghai
- [Fubo Hill](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/guilin-fubo-hill.htm): Fubo Hill: 63m riverside peak on Lijiang River with caves & legends
- [Chuanshan Park](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/guilin-chuanshan-hill-park.htm): Chuanshan Park on Lijiang River: pagoda, karst caves & photography spot

- [Top 10 Wuhan Delicacies](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/wuhan-top-delicacies.htm): Top 10 Wuhan street food delicacies featuring Hot and Dry Noodles
- [Xiamen Snack Streets](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/xiamen-snack-streets.htm): Xiamen food streets guide featuring Zhongshan Road & local cuisine spots
- [6 Types of Chinese Tea](https://www.chinaeducationaltours.com/guide/culture-chinese-tea-types.htm): Six Chinese tea types: green, white, yellow, oolong, black & dark tea
